bug_description: A stack overflow occurs in flexbuffers::Reference::ToString() (include/flatbuffers/flexbuffers.h:600) in Google FlatBuffers via unbounded mutual recursion with AppendToString<Vector> (flexbuffers.h:387). The functions recurse through every nesting level of a flexbuffer vector with no depth tracking. A crafted 31-byte flexbuffer containing deeply-nested vectors passes flexbuffers::VerifyBuffer (which does not cap recursion depth for legitimate non-overlapping containers) and then crashes any consumer that calls ToString on the verified root reference. The stack overflows after approximately 245 recursive frames.

secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR flatbuffers.issue-9074..."
    ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /src/repro_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/flatbuffers
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"

    case "$command" in
        build)
            build "$@"
            ;;
        repro)
            repro "$@"
            ;;
        patch)
            patch "$@"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown command: $command"
            echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
ENV SANITIZER=address
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git cmake ninja-build clang \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN cd $SRC && \
    git init flatbuffers && cd flatbuffers && \
    git remote add origin https://github.com/google/flatbuffers.git && \
    git fetch --depth=1 origin e223d69b36574c4a2b10dbd27761753de81624ab && \
    git checkout FETCH_HEAD && \
    rm -rf .git && git init && \
    git config user.email "secbench@local" && \
    git config user.name "secbench" && \
    git add -A && git commit -m "flatbuffers at e223d69b (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/flatbuffers
RUN cmake -S . -B build-asan -G Ninja \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
    -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATC=OFF && \
    ninja -C build-asan flatbuffers
COPY repro.cc $SRC/repro.cc
RUN clang++ -std=c++17 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1 \
    -I $SRC/flatbuffers/include \
    $SRC/repro.cc \
    $SRC/flatbuffers/build-asan/libflatbuffers.a \
    -o $SRC/repro_bin -lpthread
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.bin /testcase/poc.bin
COPY build.sh $SRC/
COPY secb.sh /usr/local/bin/secb
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/secb

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/google/flatbuffers/issues/9074
## Description:
Issue: google/flatbuffers#9074
Title: Unbounded Recursion / Stack Overflow in flexbuffers::Reference::ToString via Nested Vectors
State: open
Created at: 2026-05-05

Issue Body:
flexbuffers::Reference::ToString (include/flatbuffers/flexbuffers.h:598-666) and its helper AppendToString<Vector> (flexbuffers.h:375-397) recurse unconditionally through every level of a nested flexbuffers vector with zero depth tracking. flexbuffers::VerifyBuffer accepts legitimate (non-cyclic) deeply-nested vectors without rejecting them, so a 31-byte crafted flexbuffer passes verification and then blows the stack on the subsequent ToString call (~245 recursive frames before the guard page fires).

Any consumer that pretty-prints an attacker-controlled flexbuffer — logging, debug dumps, JSON bridges, TFLite metadata loaders — takes a stack-overflow crash.

Root cause: ToString delegates to AppendToString<Vector>, which walks every child and calls child.ToString() on each, which re-enters ToString on the nested vector. This is mutual recursion with no depth cap and no stack-budget check.

Vulnerable code:
- flexbuffers::Reference::ToString (flexbuffers.h:598-666)
- flexbuffers::AppendToString<Vector> (flexbuffers.h:375-397)

Vulnerable version: commit e223d69b36574c4a2b10dbd27761753de81624ab
